| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-brought-me-back the-way-of the-gate-of the-outer sanctuary which faces east, and-it [was] shut. |
| LOGOS | Then he brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, which faces east. And it was shut. |
| PNEUMA | Then the man brought me back to the outer eastern gateway of the sanctuary — and it was shut. |
